purpose: Predeclare Phase 1 corpus and model evidence requirements before CNN, calibration, policy, or scanner decisions.

selection_protocol.model_selection: Choose one predeclared configuration using validation only.
selection_protocol.calibration: Fit calibration parameters on calibration only after model selection.
selection_protocol.test: Use once for final confirmation; never tune corpus, configuration, calibration, or policy against test results.

data_readiness.note: A one-percent empirical FPR claim is not evaluable for a class/split with fewer than 100 one-vs-rest negatives.

baseline_selection_targets.fixed_fpr_requirement: Report the actual negative support. Mark the one-percent target not evaluable rather than interpreting a coarser empirical point as one percent.

later_calibration_and_policy_targets.rule: Evaluate calibration and abstention only after their separate Python POCs exist; they are not silently inferred from uncalibrated baseline scores.

phase_2_entry: Targets must be recorded and the leakage-safe corpus/split must pass. Baseline target failure is evidence for data or model work, not permission to tune on test or emit scanner decisions.
scanner_decision_entry: All applicable data, selection, calibration, policy, privacy, and later performance targets must pass on the final held-out evaluation.
